brief:
Israeli occupation forces detained several Palestinians and prevented them from accessing their land in Halhul, a town north of Hebron, Eye on Palestine reported. The detentions and access restrictions were imposed as residents attempted to reach their property.

No additional details on the number of detainees, duration of detention, or stated reasons for the restrictions were provided in available reports.

title: Israeli forces detain Palestinians, block land access in Halhul
